tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (Rich Orange, C0 M72 Y60 K0). The colour people know Mastery Academy by: poster fields, the logomark on ink, the coral title rule, primary buttons. Put ink text on it (6.4:1); white text on coral is only 2.8:1 — the brand uses it for big poster headlines, keep it to 40px+ display type and never for body copy.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (Rich Black, C83 M75 Y58 K82). Logo ink, text on white/cream, the dark ground of covers and apps.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (C0 M21 Y77 K0). Colour fields, tags and highlight panels. Ink text only (12.1:1).

tokens.name: purple
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour (C68 M65 Y0 K0). Colour fields, retail/app panels. Ink text for body (4.6:1); white only at 24px+ (3.9:1). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C58 M0 Y0 K0). Colour fields and tags; ink text only.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C0 M82 Y24 K0). Colour fields and tags; ink text (5.6:1). Doubles as the danger fill.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C62 M0 Y33 K0). Colour fields, filled icons; ink text only.

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C24 M44 Y0 K0). Colour fields and tags; ink text only.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C63 M0 Y65 K0). Colour fields, the green mark on ink; ink text only. Doubles as the success fill.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Secondary colour (C0 M0 Y11 K0). Warm paper ground for presentations and long-form pages; ink text on it.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Paper white. Default light ground; logo reversed out of colour fields.

tokens.name: black
tokens.usage: Pure black from the Grays swatch group. Sunken areas on the dark theme only; use ink for everything else.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background: white in light, ink in dark.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternating bands and cards: cream in light, black in dark.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface and surface-alt (≥17:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, running headers ("Design System / 01"), captions on surface and surface-alt (≥5:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the full-width rules above running headers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 1px rules that carry structure (the guide's black rules), outline-button borders.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: primary actions, the short title rule, active states. Fill only — never small text on white.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent (coral) fills, 6.4:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring on every interactive element: 3.9:1 on white, 4.6:1 on ink, visible on coral.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success fill with ink text; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning fill with ink text; always paired with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error fill with ink text; always paired with a word or icon (never told apart from success by hue alone).

styles.name: display

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Page titles; followed by the coral title rule.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The logo contains sharp and non-curved corners.

styles.name: ar-display

styles.name: ar-body

styles.name: poster

tokens.name: radius-control

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: fill-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of soft buttons. Text colour never changes on hover.

tokens.name: fill-soft-active
tokens.usage: Pressed soft, ghost and bare buttons.

tokens.name: rule-hairline
tokens.usage: Every rule and outline in the system.
